name: Bangladesh (1971–1972)
description: A green field with a red disc slightly towards the hoist bearing a golden-orange map of Bangladesh.
history: The flag of the Bangladesh Liberation War, first raised at Dhaka University on 2 March 1971 and hoisted by Sheikh Mujibur Rahman at his Dhanmondi home on 23 March 1971; the golden map of the country inside the red sun marked the new state. The map was removed when the flag was officially adopted on 17 January 1972.
